name: Cornerstone Project
description: This course serves as a capstone/cornerstone project for MSc students in cognitive science. Students will identify a substantive research or design problem, develop a project proposal, execute the project (empirical, computational, theoretical or applied), analyse results, and present their findings in a written thesis‐style report and an oral defence/presentation. The content will be as per the project assigned.
